coordinates: Millimeters; x left to right, y front to rear, z above floor. Positions are minimum corners; sizes are x/y/z. View directions do not define robot-control coordinates.

reservations.label: Dirty-air duct corridor
reservations.note: Outside routing reservation, not a promised clear bore or finished duct; meets head and drawer at faces.

reservations.label: Rear-pull bin + filter drawer
reservations.note: Includes filter holder on left and rear evacuation port; slide rear after retracting clean-air seal face.

reservations.label: CBM blower / mount bay
reservations.note: Blower upright: intake toward +x/filter, tangential outlet toward +y/rear. Mount and adapters to detail.

reservations.label: Clean-air plenum + seal release
reservations.note: Fixed plenum beside drawer; retract its sealing face 3 mm toward -x before drawer slides rear. Include station-evacuation isolation here.

reservations.label: Rear exhaust turn / diffuser
reservations.note: Reserve rear/upward discharge above floor; diffuser area and pressure loss unverified.

reservations.label: Wheel H-bridge / terminal bay
reservations.note: Above dirty duct with a sealed separating deck; Cytron PCB reference below, terminal/cooling space provisional.

reservations.label: Bottom MCU / encoder interface
reservations.note: Vertical or stacked carriers proposed; includes CAN and encoder level conversion; no board fit release.

reservations.label: Roller / brush / blower power
reservations.note: Unselected protected power stages; reserve stack space. Wheel H-bridge channels are not available for these loads.

reservations.label: Side brush swept allowance
reservations.note: 70 mm sweep diameter is an unmeasured placeholder; actual brush may require moving the head or growing the outline.

reservations.label: Front compliant caster allowance
reservations.note: Includes swivel sweep; suspension/preload must keep traction on drive wheels.

reservations.label: Outward camera / near-field bay
reservations.note: Optical apertures and field of view remain to design; this does not prove pet or stair detection.

reservations.label: Core left station pickup rail
reservations.note: Captured by station from the side, above battery service path; load-bearing section not sized.

reservations.label: Core-fixed scanner pedestal
reservations.note: Passes through cap opening; scanner stays with core during cap exchange.

reservations.label: Bottom floating connector pocket
reservations.note: Combined mating reservation, not a selected connector or pinout; all dirt service is aft.

notes: All positions and reservation sizes are proposals, including unselected motors, transmission, casters, sensors, regulators, power stages, latches and connector housings.
Only owned rollers/filter/wheel dimensions, identified manufacturer envelopes, and clearly marked listing references are represented as part dimensions.
Reservations include their internal reference parts; do not sum their volumes or masses. Unallocated gaps are for segmented structure, seals and harness routing, not validated free space.
Structural seats/posts and panels are not solid modeled here; latch coordinates establish joint zones, not rated locks, through-hole patterns or an approved shared interface.
Floor body envelope excludes the side brush sweep. Its unknown real size must be resolved before printing adjacent parts.
Three caster reservations require compliant mounting and drive-wheel load control; contact geometry alone does not establish stability or traction.
No total mass, center of gravity, cleaning performance, runtime, autonomous reliability or lifting ability is established. All propulsion work remains deferred.
